releaseNotes: v1.9.8: Letters to Contractor with reason and date received; weekly report VIII lists that week's developer requests and letters; signatories get an Office (Bulacan District Office or Region 3 Office) under the position; Documents has Suspension / Resumption (with continuances), Time Extensions, Variation Orders and Letters tabs; printing opens a zoomable preview; photos open full screen with pinch zoom; Needs attention shows only when something needs action.
